# Kronos AI

Canonical website: https://kronos.lifestyle/
Category: K-line forecasting and OHLCV readiness workspace
Support: support@aigeamy.com

Kronos AI turns market history into reviewable forecast paths, volatility ranges, regime notes, and evaluation handoffs. It is a managed experience built around the public Kronos research project, not the official upstream project itself.

Core pages:
- Home: https://kronos.lifestyle/
- Method: https://kronos.lifestyle/#method
- Pricing: https://kronos.lifestyle/pricing/
- Resources: https://kronos.lifestyle/resources/
- Guides: https://kronos.lifestyle/guides/
- Documentation: https://kronos.lifestyle/docs/

Primary sources:
- Repository: https://github.com/shiyu-coder/Kronos
- Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.02739
- Demo: https://shiyu-coder.github.io/Kronos/

Boundaries:
- Forecasts are uncertain and are not financial advice.
- Results depend on data quality, horizon, cadence, and market regime.
- The hosted workflow does not guarantee market outcomes.
